_readme: RT1 (2026-11-15): the COMMITTED half of the runtime lane's per-script kill list. runtime_definitions.kill_list()
serves the UNION of these entries and PINE_RUNTIME_KILL_LIST (the variable stays the operator's instant switch).
A listed script falls back OFF the runtime lane at every door (preview, save, served rows, the server lanes),
refused by name with its `reason`. Nothing is deleted: removing an entry brings the script back on the next read.
An entry comes off ONLY when its `liftWhen` is met (an engine fix, then a re-grade to MATCH on the named captures).
tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py holds every entry to its evidence capture (a committed runtime-on verdict
that is not MATCH, on a capture whose source hashes to the entry's sha256). Edit as text.

Lifted: trend-targets-algoalpha (PR #1374), parabolic-sar (2026-11-16, round_to_mintick on a half tick, both captures MATCH), contraction-box-doji-lines (engine 78, Pine's tolerant compare, #1858: the extra line was a near-tie comparison, and both SPY captures re-grade MATCH runtime-on, run 44319610649).
Empty is a valid state: the by-name rails use a synthetic entry (tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py).
DRAW-1 (2026-11-16): seven scripts newly admitted by obj:box / obj:table have a committed capture grading DIVERGE on
either lane, so each is killed here until its liftWhen (rail: test_DRAW1_every_newly_admitted_object_script_with_a_DIVERGE_capture_is_killed).

Engine 68 regrade (feat/pine-host-known-divergence, 2026-11-17): seven probes newly graded DIVERGE are killed until their liftWhen: vw-h5-format-volume, vw-w3-format-date, vw-w3-loop-helper-text, vw-w3-str-repeat-length (admitted by obj:table, DRAW-1 rule) and vw-imp-change-before-reassign, vw-w4-series-length, vw-w4-series-length-v4 (drawn by the runtime lane under admission, the REACH stop rule).

HELD kills (2026-11-18): an entry with `status: "pending"` is recorded here and NOT served (runtime_definitions.kill_entry_is_served is the one rule: committed_kills and the coverage census both skip it; the script still draws); it names its evidence capture, its liftWhen and a hard `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD), and the REACH rail accepts that one capture as a stop only until then. Past `expires` the rails are red on their own. LIFTED 2026-11-18 on its liftWhen: adx-and-di-for-v4 (Q-FCMP ruled TOLERANCE, packet 56330c15e071; engine 78 #1858 compares within 1e-10; adx-and-di-for-v4-spy-1d-2026-11-17 re-graded MATCH on the runtime-on lane). The list holds no held kill now; the rails show the rule on a synthetic one.

U-STMT PR 1 (#1930, engine 82, 2026-11-18): machine-learning-moving-average-backquant is killed by the REACH stop rule. `ta.change(source, length)` on the runtime lane builds it, and under admission the door now draws it on that lane; its RDDT captures grade MATCH, its SPY capture DIVERGE (the run stops at the array-operation limit and draws nothing). Records spliced from that PR's pine-heavy run 44427583401.

CO-2 (#1984, engine NUMBER PENDING, 2026-11-19): volatility-coil-edge-bullbyte is killed by the REACH stop rule. Theme colours on the runtime lane (`chart.fg_color` / `chart.bg_color`) build it, and under admission the door now draws it on that lane; all three of its captures grade DIVERGE (TradingView paints its "Signal Bar BG" background, ours does not). Records spliced from that PR's pine-heavy run 44482355116.
